extension.description: Shows a full-screen slideshow of photos from a chosen folder (by default /storage/Slideshow/photos, or a subfolder of it - e.g. one per trip/album - picked via the Photos folder setting). Seconds per photo, random order, background color and photo fit are configured via this addon's own Settings screen. Left/Right on the remote goes to the previous/next photo, Pause/Play pauses and resumes the auto-advance, and Back exits. Photos are scaled per the Photo fit setting against an opaque background, and Kodi's own screensaver is held off while it runs. When Random order is off, photos play in the order they were actually taken (from EXIF date), not filename order. Portrait photos stored sideways with an EXIF rotation tag are automatically corrected (requires Pillow/PIL in Kodi's Python; falls back to showing them as-is otherwise) via a cached copy, without touching the original files. Ships with a handful of sample photos, shown automatically the first time the default photos folder is empty. Optionally shows a small caption with the date each photo was taken (from its EXIF data) in the corner of the screen. Each photo's EXIF orientation and date are read once and cached, rather than re-read from disk on every display, so navigation and exit stay responsive even for large NAS-hosted photo folders.
